create_PredictionErrorDisplay: create a PredictionErrorDisplay to visualize regression model prediction errors with true and predicted values
build_PredictionErrorDisplay_from_estima: build a PredictionErrorDisplay from a fitted regressor and data to plot residuals vs predicted values
build_PredictionErrorDisplay_from_predic: build a PredictionErrorDisplay from true and predicted targets with optional subsampling and random state
test_PredictionErrorDisplay_plot: test the PredictionErrorDisplay.plot method to generate actual_vs_predicted or residual_vs_predicted scatter plots
review_PredictionErrorDisplay: review the PredictionErrorDisplay class that visualizes regression prediction errors using matplotlib scatter plots
